claim: Aligned base-layer-measure objects preserve declared support semantics
stop_rule: demote any operation that silently changes support semantics

claim: Registered spatial null procedures control their declared familywise error
estimand: rejection probability under the registered null
stop_rule: demote failing method to experimental and remove calibrated-null wording

claim: Resampling obeys its declared gather or conservative-remap contract
estimand: target value or conserved mass under a known transform
primary_gate: predefined error and conservation bounds both pass
stop_rule: gate unsupported method and geometry combinations

claim: Group permutation inference preserves the declared independent unit
estimand: group contrast over declared independent units under an exchangeability schedule
primary_gate: coverage 0.93 to 0.97 with type-I upper CI at most 0.065 and wrong-unit inputs rejected
stop_rule: restrict site-confounded stable designs to blocked or block-respecting user schedules

claim: Cross-atlas inference accounts for correlated atlas estimates
stop_rule: make descriptive output default and require opt-in for independence

claim: Operator ensembles propagate simplex-consistent support uncertainty
estimand: target mean and uncertainty under an operator distribution
primary_gate: bias and RMSE improve or match ablations and coverage is 0.93 to 0.97
stop_rule: limit stable claim to empirical weighted ensembles

claim: Spatial regression methods match named reference estimands and uncertainty
estimand: model-specific coefficient and interval under declared metric
primary_gate: reference tolerance plus type-I and coverage gates pass
stop_rule: rename demote or remove mismatched methods

claim: Core sparse workflows remain within declared scale budgets
estimand: numerical result and resource use at registered scale
primary_gate: all seven time memory sparsity and accuracy gates pass
